pixelPolicy: Generated PNGs copied unchanged; only read-only alpha analysis used. No image transforms or background extraction.
cropMethod: Main connected alpha>0 silhouette plus four pixels padding, preserving complete physical object and soft contact shadow; exact crops avoid adjoining sprites.

atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment sprite atlas for the original top-down RPG Ash & Aether. Generate one wide landscape 2:1 PNG, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, exactly EIGHT separate complete game props. Every prop stays INSIDE its own equal cell, with at least 8 percent clear transparent space on ALL sides and empty transparent gutters. No piece crosses into another cell. Rich original hand-painted fantasy RPG artwork, elegant readable silhouettes, subtly irregular rounded natural forms, physical weathered material detail, gentle upper-left lighting. Consistent 35-degree elevated orthographic camera, visible fronts and tops, all props grounded toward bottom of their cells. Polished indie RPG art, nuanced brushwork, warm ochre clay, muted petrol blue stone, oxidized copper and aged brass where appropriate. Genuine RGBA transparency, clean cutout silhouettes, only tiny soft contact shadow under each prop. No background color, no checkerboard, no rectangle platforms or large landscape bases, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no numbers, no people or animals, no decorative borders. Eight props must be spatially separated and unmistakably distinct. INDUSTRY AND RAIL KIT. Exact left-to-right top row: 1 small rounded terracotta clay kiln with arched dark fire mouth, brick lip and short chimney; 2 bronze casting basin and blacksmith tongs on a compact squat blue-stone plinth; 3 compact hand-operated bellows and anvil workstand, worn oak and dark iron with brass rivets; 4 old iron railway buffer with a weathered steel wheel and a very short fragment of paired rails. Bottom row: 5 curved copper pipe assembly with large verdigris valve wheel, mounted on two small stone feet; 6 jagged but rounded basalt outcrop split by thin warm ember veins, no floating flame; 7 small wooden ore cart loaded with copper ore and coal, believable four iron wheels; 8 sculptural dark slag chimney vent on a rocky base, hollow warm mouth, no smoke beyond the object. Preserve exact 4 by 2 order and generous gutters.

deliveryPolicy.originals: Original generated PNG bytes, hashes, prompts and generation paths remain unchanged. archivedSourcePath identifies the retained source file; originalProductionPath records its former runtime location.
deliveryPolicy.runtime: delivery.file is the WebP loaded by the browser. Color uses FFmpeg libwebp quality 95, compression level 6; alpha is exact. Dimensions, crop coordinates, source parts and anchors are unchanged.
deliveryPolicy.validation: Existing crop and silhouette measurements refer to the original PNG. Delivery dimensions and exact alpha are verified in development/art/delivery-v17.json.
